beats.text: Rama's army camped at the gates of Lanka, and Rama looked up at the golden city where Sita was held.
Before war, Rama gave Ravana one last chance. He sent Prince Angada, Vali's son, as his messenger.
Angada walked into the demon king's court without fear, and stood before the ten-headed king.
Ravana mocked him. 'Your father was my friend. Why serve the man who killed him?'
'Return Sita,' Angada said. When the court laughed, he planted his foot and said, 'If any of you can move it, Rama will go home.'
One by one, the mightiest demons strained and pulled. No one could move it.
Even Ravana rose to try. Angada stepped back. 'Do not touch my feet. Touch Rama's feet, and you will be saved.'
Ravana did not listen. The last chance for peace was gone. Angada leapt through the palace roof and flew back to Rama.
